regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked, Non-Participating, Group Savings Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Fund-based group ULIP to manage employer obligations: gratuity, leave encashment, superannuation, employee welfare, post-retirement medical benefits (PRMBS)
Choice of Pooled Unit Fund or Individual Unit Fund management
Choice of 11 investment funds with unlimited free switches
Life cover for employees (mortality charge deducted monthly from the unit fund)
Additional units added on each policy anniversary based on average fund size
Investment strategies for superannuation: Self-Managed and Wheel of Life portfolio strategy
Surrender value equals the unit fund value as on date of surrender

eligibility.policy_term: Group employer-employee scheme; governed by scheme rules (no fixed individual policy term)
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Contributions as per scheme funding rules — no minimum contribution, no maximum limit stated
eligibility.note: This is an Employer-Employee group fund-based plan; member-level numeric eligibility is governed by scheme rules, not a fixed table. Partial withdrawal, top-up premium and loans are NOT available.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document (electronic or otherwise); on cancellation, units are repurchased at NAV on date of cancellation.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days (all modes other than monthly); 15 days (monthly).
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death of an employee due to suicide, the death benefit as defined in the scheme rules is payable — no suicide exclusion applies under this plan.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: There is NO maturity benefit in this plan; benefits are paid per scheme rules by cancelling units. Partial withdrawal, top-up and loans are not allowed.
key_terms.fund_charges_note: Premium Allocation Charge, Mortality Charge (deducted monthly from units) and Fund Management Charge (up to 1.35% p.a.) apply; charges subject to GST and to revision with 3 months' notice and IRDAI approval.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws'; GST applicable per prevailing tax laws. Trust setup under Income Tax Act 1961 / Rules 1962 may be required.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Section 38 - Assignment (Not Applicable for this plan)
Force Majeure / NAV deferral conditions per IRDAI (ULIP) Regulations 2024
Mandatory ULIP risk statement: 'IN THIS POLICY, THE INVESTMENT RISK IN INVESTMENT PORTFOLIO IS BORNE BY THE POLICYHOLDER'

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a UNIT-LINKED group plan — the investment risk in the investment portfolio is borne by the policyholder; the mandatory market-risk statement must accompany any returns/fund-performance reference.
Fund values are NAV-driven and depend on market performance — no returns are guaranteed.
It is an Employer-Employee group plan only (policyholder must be the trustee or employer); benefits are paid per scheme rules.
Fund Management Charge is capped at 1.35% p.a.; surrender value = unit fund value, with no guaranteed floor.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns', 'assured returns', 'bonus' or any capital-protection language — it is a non-participating market-linked fund product with no guaranteed benefits.
Do NOT omit the mandatory ULIP risk disclosure ('investment risk ... borne by the policyholder').
Do NOT advertise maturity benefit, loans, partial withdrawal or top-up — none are available under this plan.
Do NOT present past or illustrative fund performance as indicative of future returns.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-Linked, Non-Participating, Group Savings Insurance Plan'
The mandatory ULIP risk statement: 'In this policy, the investment risk in investment portfolio is borne by the policyholder'
Linked insurance products are different from traditional products and are subject to risk factors; that this is a group scheme governed by scheme rules
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document for full terms, conditions and exclusions

gaps: Fund composition tables, charge tables and eligibility figures are rendered as images/tables in the brochure and were not recovered as text from the parse.
